g.text: Objective: check the alert channel, then copy today's positions, cash, corporate actions and new fills from Interactive Brokers into the database.

text.tspan: bot portfolio starts
preset damodaran_value.yaml missing: exit code two, after the notifier check

g.text: the run ends with exit code two before any sync
the run ends with exit code 1 before the snapshot

text.tspan: today's snapshot and cash are stored
idempotent per (snapshot_date, account): that day's rows of the account are deleted, then inserted

g.text: the corporate actions are fetched, skipped or failed
the run ends with exit code 1 after the snapshot
its mark events and concentration are settled

text.tspan: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) Trader Workstation (TWS)
or the Interactive Brokers Gateway, read-only socket through ib_async
BOT_IBKR_HOST, BOT_IBKR_PORT, BOT_IBKR_CLIENT_ID
IBKR Flex Web Service: an Activity Flex Query,
a send request, then polls until the statement is ready
Comes out:
today's snapshot rows (positions with a market value or unpriced), cash by currency, new corporate actions and new fills
the notifier check fails [a missing setting, or a password in cleartext]
BOT_NOTIFIER email needs BOT_SMTP_HOST, BOT_SMTP_FROM, BOT_SMTP_TO; telegram needs BOT_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, BOT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
the notifier check passes [no channel, or every setting present]
BOT_NOTIFIER none sends nothing; email and telegram need their settings

g.text: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) Trader Workstation (TWS) cannot be reached [connection error or timeout]

text.tspan: its position is stored with a market value [a close, converted when its currency differs]

market value = quantity × latest close, in the position's currency; latest close = newest prices_daily close on or before the snapshot date, in its listing currency; when that differs from the position's currency: close × rate_to_usd of the listing currency ÷ rate_to_usd of the position's currency, nearest prior rates from currencies; either currency unknown: close used as is
its position is stored unpriced [no close, a close of 0 or less, or a missing rate]
the market value is left empty; a rate of 0 or less counts as missing

g.text: the snapshot is stored without it [no account holds it any more]

text.tspan: no corporate action is fetched [Flex token or query id not set]
only when BOT_IBKR_FLEX_TOKEN and BOT_IBKR_FLEX_QUERY_ID are set
new corporate actions are stored from the IBKR Flex Web Service
dividend cash transactions → dividend, action_id ct:<id>; forward and reverse splits → split; any other type kept lower-cased, action_id ca:<id>; inserted de-duplicated on action_id
the corporate actions step fails and a warning is logged
the run goes on

g.text: TWS cannot be reached for the trades [connection error or timeout]

text.tspan: the fills at or after the newest stored one are added
per account: all fills TWS retains are fetched; watermark = newest executed_at stored for the account; inserted de-duplicated on exec_id; timestamps stored as naive Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

g.text: it is held today [its summed quantity is not 0]
it is neither marked nor weighed [no longer held]

text.tspan: [always: the new fills are stored]
new fills
